definition.name: theta-idempotent-approximation-map
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:527-528, the definitional display inside Proposition prop_P — ONLY the definition is citable, the proposition's claims must be re-proved): \wt{P}=\theta(2P-I), where \theta(X)=\frac{1}{2}(I+\sgn(X)). This is the map \theta referenced by def-compressed-corner's display Co_{P,Q}=\theta(L_P R_Q + R_Q L_P - 1) (tex:1057).
